subject: Leaflet: Getting marker location using layerId

messages.author: 28cd5cfb08dca856
messages.subject: Leaflet: Getting marker location using layerId
parts:
Hello
 
I have a set of marker with known layerId in a Shiny Leaflet map which the user can drag. I would like to access the current lat/lng data of a marker with a given layerId. I know that one can access the lat/lng if the user clicks on the marker via the observeEvent "input$map_marker_click", but that is not helpful in this case.
 
I wrote the following simplistic code to show the problem:
library(leaflet)
library(shiny)
ui <- fluidPage(
  leafletOutput("map"),
  actionButton("print","print")
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
 
  # Create leaflet map and add add marker
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    m <- leaflet()
    m <- addTiles(m)
    m <- addMarkers(m, lng=60, lat=0, layerId="A",options = markerOptions(clickable = TRUE, draggable = TRUE))
  })
 
  # Save changes of bus stop data
  observeEvent(input$print, {
    print("how to access lat/long of marker with layerId A?")
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)

What formula do I need to write in the print line to retrieve the current latitude and longitude of marker A? Does anyone have experience with this problem or knows how to solve this?

Best wishes
Tom
